crossRefs.note: He said to them, “Follow me; for Yahweh has delivered your enemies the Moabites into your hand.” They followed him, and…
The men of Israel were gathered together out of Naphtali, out of Asher, and out of all Manasseh, and pursued Midian.
Saul and all the people who were with him were gathered together, and came to the battle; and behold, they were all…
The men of Israel and of Judah arose and shouted, and pursued the Philistines as far as Gai and to the gates of Ekron.…
This is an easy thing in Yahweh’s sight. He will also deliver the Moabites into your hand.
When they came to the camp of Israel, the Israelites rose up and struck the Moabites, so that they fled before them…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Syria
people.line: Ancient region north of Israel, often in conflict

translations.web: The king of Israel went out, and struck the horses and chariots, and killed the Syrians with a great slaughter.
translations.bsb: Then the king of Israel marched out and attacked the horses and chariots, inflicting a great slaughter on the Arameans.
translations.kjv: And the king of Israel went out, and smote the horses and chariots, and slew the Syrians with a great slaughter.
translations.asv: And the king of Israel went out, and smote the horses and chariots, and slew the Syrians with a great slaughter.
